Microsoft Visual C++ Runtime

Microsoft Corporation. All rights reserved.

The Windows build bundles application-local Microsoft VC runtime CRT DLLs.
These vendor files retain their own Microsoft license terms and are not
relicensed under ImageLore's MIT license. Actual vendor file versions and
SHA-256 digests are recorded by the release build/runtime receipt.

Redistribution reference:
https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/visualstudio/releases/2022/redistribution

Microsoft runtime terms:
https://visualstudio.microsoft.com/license-terms/vs2022-cruntime/

Redistribution remains subject to the applicable Visual Studio/license terms.
The release uses vendor redistributable CRT files without modification; debug
non-redistributable CRT folders are excluded by the runtime staging process.
This notice records the component and official references; it does not accept
new service terms or grant rights beyond the vendor's own terms.
